thread:
sandeep: Hey team — getting reports of a surge of 5xx/timeouts hitting hosted inference gateway since 09:12 UTC. Customers A & B reporting API errors. I opened a quick triage. Logs show gateway/edge 504s and upstream connection resets. Anyone seeing related alerts? /cc @oncall-mike
emily: I see an alert flood from gateway-proxy in eu-west starting 09:11. Error pattern: upstream connection reset when proxy tries to reach runtime. p50 latency spiked. Repro via curl shows `socket hang up` and `504 Gateway Timeout` responses.
omar: I'm seeing TCP FIN+RST from runtime nodes around the same time. Could be keepalive/conntrack issue after the kernel packages rolled last night. Checking node10-14 now.
jen: Confirmed node12 shows conntrack table growth. `conntrack -L | wc -l` is very high. netstat shows many sockets in TIME_WAIT/TIME_CLOSE. Increasing keepalive short-term might help. Will try restarting nginx on node12 to see if that alleviates proxy backpressure.
triage-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-6881. Priority P1. Auto-notifications sent to SRE and Eng-Runtime.
oncall-mike: Restarting nginx on node12 now (sudo systemctl restart nginx). If that reduces 5xx rate, we'll schedule a rolling restart. Also bumping proxy upstream keepalive to 75s temporarily.
sandeep: Good. Also enabling fallback routing to dedicated pool for high-retry customers (feature flag: `route.fallback.enabled=true`). Doing staged rollout to reduce customer impact.
support-alex: Noted major customer X is affected — they've escalated to SLA team. Communicating temporary workaround: "retry with exponential backoff (1s -> 5s) and set max_retries=3". Posting initial customer advisory.
omar: Nginx restart on node12 reduced 5xxs from that host but node13 now trending up. Starting rolling restart across runtime nodes node10 -> node15, 60s between restarts to avoid thundering herd.
jen: Follow-up: enabled a conntrack cleanup cron on node13 to prune CLOSED entries and adjusted `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` as a stopgap. Patch queued to revert the kernel change in the next maintenance window.
emily: Post-restart metrics: error rate down ~85%, p95 latency back to baseline. Keeping fallback routing on for 30 minutes then we'll toggle it off if stable.
sandeep: Action items (owners): 1) Root cause analysis for kernel/conntrack interaction (Eng-Runtime: omar, jen). 2) Ops to implement automated conntrack pruning + alerted thresholds (oncall-mike). 3) Product/support to review fallback routing SLA implications and customer comms (sandeep, support-alex). 4) Postmortem owner: emily — please publish timeline, RCA, and remediation plan within 24h.
oncall-mike: I've added the emergency runbook steps to INC-2026-6881: temp fixes = restart nginx + enable route fallback; medium fix = deploy conntrack pruning and monitoring; long fix = kernel revert or upgrade and validation.
support-alex: Customer update posted and tickets escalated. Will coordinate any credit requests if SLA threshold met.
sandeep: Closing this war room thread — leaving channel open for postmortem notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
